x: Tucker, the winner, walked a brainy race against L J. Wells, of Surrey W.C, who gave a plucky display of determination in trying to hang on to Tucker when the latter made his final effort.

Khlopin and G Tucker were our only representatives at Croydon for the Surrey Walking Club's "Godstone" walk, and Tommy was unfortunate enough to arrive late and so he started 11 mins. 32 secs. after the rest of the field and yet managed to get fifth in the scratch race.
